profileLabel: Center-left economics; mixed civil liberties (low confidence)
summary: Cebu 3rd District representative with 76 principal-authored bills. Authored an expanded PhilHealth Konsulta package, a ban on greenwashing, bank transparency and anti-corruption, a single national ID, children's data protection and regulation of malicious deepfakes.
caveat: Civil-liberties score nets a surveillance-leaning single ID against privacy protection and a speech-regulating deepfake bill; thin. Bank transparency is a single institutions issue and unscored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored expanded PhilHealth Konsulta preventive care (-2) and a ban on deceptive corporate sustainability claims (-2, corporate regulation). Two issues.
